description: Finds pages of the AstralRead astrology knowledge base for a chart factor and returns each page's title, a one- or two-sentence summary and its link. Understands planets in signs and houses ('Moon in Taurus', 'Mars in 10th house'), Ascendant/MC signs, aspects ('Venus square Saturn'), houses ('7th house'), patterns ('grand trine', 'T-square', 'yod'), North Node and Chiron placements, and transits ('Saturn transit Aries', 'transiting Saturn square Venus', 'Saturn return'). English or Russian.
